title: How much does motion design cost in 2026?
meta_title: Motion Design Cost in 2026 (EUR) — Akdeinz Motion
description: Motion design costs in 2026: freelancer marketplace vs studio vs Akdeinz Motion’s fixed prices from €390 to €2,400 excl. VAT, with turnaround times.
answer: Motion design usually costs somewhere between a few tens of euros on freelancer marketplaces and several thousand euros at a studio, depending on length, complexity and licence. Akdeinz Motion publishes fixed prices in EUR excl. VAT: from €390 for a 3–6 second Logo Sting (3 working days) to €2,400 for a Brand Film of up to 60 seconds (10–14 working days).

diy.intro: Doing it yourself looks free, but it costs hours and usually a subscription. The honest comparison is your hours multiplied by what your time is worth, plus tools and licences.

tools.name: Canva and CapCut
tools.note: Free tiers exist; paid plans add features and assets. Fast for simple posts.

tools.name: Jitter
tools.note: Browser-based motion design with more control than a template tool.

tools.name: After Effects
tools.note: Paid Adobe subscription, plus a long learning curve before the work looks professional.

steps: Estimate the hours: a first short social animation is often 1–3 hours in a template tool, and a polished 30–60 second video takes far longer.
Multiply the hours by your own hourly rate. Example only: at €50/hour, 10 hours is €500.
Add tool subscriptions and any music, font or stock licences you need.
Compare the total with a fixed quote, and include the risk that the result has to be redone.
diy.hours: A realistic range for a first 30-second promo made from scratch is 6–15 hours. At an example rate of €50/hour that is €300–€750 of your time, before any subscription.

sections.h2: What drives the price of motion design
ul: Length: every extra second needs more design and animation work.
Complexity: custom illustration and character work cost more than animated text and shapes.
Formats: 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 each need their own layout (Akdeinz Motion includes all three).
Revisions: how many rounds of changes are included and what an extra one costs.
Music, sound design and voiceover: licensed audio has to be paid for by someone.
Licence: where and for how long you may use the video, including paid ads.
Speed: rush work is normally priced higher (Akdeinz Motion: +35% under 72 hours).

diy_fine.p: A cheaper route is fine when:
ul: The video is short-lived, for example a one-week promotion.
You need many quick variations and a template look is acceptable.
You are validating an idea before spending real budget.
You have a monthly volume low enough that the hours are not a problem.
diy_fine.not_fine: If you need several ads each month, a retainer is cheaper per ad: Motion Monthly 4 is 4 × Social Motion Ad S for €1,590 per month (€397.50 per ad instead of €490), and Motion Monthly 8 is €2,890 per month (€361.25 per ad), with a 3-month minimum.

faq.q: How much does a motion graphics video cost?
faq.a: With Akdeinz Motion: €390 for a Logo Sting, €490 for a Social Motion Ad up to 15 s, €790 up to 30 s, €1,290 for a Product Promo, €1,900 for an Explainer and €2,400 for a Brand Film. All prices are excl. VAT.

faq.q: Are music and sound design included?
faq.a: Yes. Licensed music and sound design are included in every package.

faq.q: How much do extra seconds cost?
faq.a: For Product Promo, Explainer and Brand Film, each extra 15 seconds is +€600 and +2 working days.
